description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for reverse indexing of pack files in a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for loading, verifying, and translating indices and offsets within pack and multi-pack structures.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex
methods.description: Populates the reverse index for a given pack, returning 0 on success or a negative value on failure.

methods.name: verify_pack_revindex
methods.description: Checks if the on-disk rev-index matches the one generated from scratch for a pack.

methods.name: load_midx_revindex
methods.description: Loads the '.rev' file of a multi-pack index via mmap, setting internal pointers.

methods.name: close_midx_revindex
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a multi-pack reverse index.

methods.name: offset_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts an object offset to its position within the pack, loading the index if necessary.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_index
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to an index-relative position.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_offset
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to a byte offset within the pack.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_midx
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to a multi-pack index position.

methods.name: midx_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a multi-pack index position to a pack position.

methods.name: midx_pair_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a pair of pack ID and offset to a pack position within a multi-pack index.
